latest.title: Trauma analgesia safety confirmed across four drug classes
latest.finding: All four agent classes (opioids, ketamine, methoxyflurane, paracetamol) showed effectiveness; no drug-attributed serious adverse events except one opioid study, with minor effects like nausea and drowsiness common.

latest.title: Undertriage in trauma linked with higher in-hospital mortality
latest.finding: Undertriage rate 53%; adjusted risk ratio for in-hospital mortality 1.19 (95% CI 1.07–1.33); shorter length of stay (-0.29 days); over-60s less likely to be discharged home (aRR 0.95).

latest.title: Prehospital blood linked to arrival hypocalcaemia in trauma
latest.finding: 235 patients hypocalcaemic and 39 hypercalcaemic on arrival, both associated with lower survival; 77 of 136 (56.6%) who received prehospital blood were hypocalcaemic; 5 hypercalcaemic patients had received prehospital calcium, suggesting possible iatrogenic hypercalcaemia.

latest.title: Prehospital SBP ≥180 linked with worse stroke outcomes
latest.finding: SBP ≥180 vs <120 mmHg: adjusted OR 0.43 (95% CI 0.22–0.84) for mRS 0–2 at 90 days; significant in EVT-treated patients, not in non-EVT patients (interaction p=0.007); haemorrhagic complications similar across groups.
